To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the host response during infective endocarditits can be assessed by a whole genome gene expression profile of circulating blood and that S100A11 could be used as a diagnostic marker of infective endocardiitis and that AQP9 could be used as an early prognostic factor of infective endcardiitis.

the host response in IE is dominated by a proinflammatory and innate immune transcriptional program, that S100A11 is a promising diagnostic biomarker of IE, and that AQP9 is a potential marker of acute heart failure in IE patients.

the gene expression profile in blood of patients with IE was significantly different from that in healthy controls and patients with excluded infection, and that the upregulation expression of the gene S100A11 was associated with the occurrence and severity of IE.
